description: Unit test script for sales pipeline analytics report in ERPNext CRM module, including setup functions for test data.

classes.name: TestSalesPipelineAnalytics
classes.description: Unit test class for sales pipeline analytics report

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up test data by deleting existing opportunities and creating company, customer, and opportunity records

methods.name: test_sales_pipeline_analytics
methods.description: Main test method executing various filter-based report checks

methods.name: check_for_monthly_and_number
methods.description: Checks report output for monthly opportunity count grouped by owner and sales stage

methods.name: check_for_monthly_and_amount
methods.description: Checks report output for monthly opportunity amount grouped by owner and sales stage

methods.name: check_for_quarterly_and_number
methods.description: Checks report output for quarterly opportunity count grouped by owner and sales stage

methods.name: check_for_quarterly_and_amount
methods.description: Checks report output for quarterly opportunity amount grouped by owner and sales stage

methods.name: check_for_all_filters
methods.description: Checks report output with all filters applied including date range and opportunity source

methods.name: create_company
methods.description: Creates a test company record if it does not exist

methods.name: create_customer
methods.description: Creates a test customer record if it does not exist

methods.name: create_opportunity
methods.description: Creates a test opportunity record linked to the customer and company if it does not exist
